meta.scope: Thailand Batch 6 — Health (life expectancy), defence expenditure, and digital / e-commerce densification.

candidates.title: Life expectancy and vital statistics
candidates.description: Official life expectancy at birth and related vital statistics. Female life expectancy is around 80 years; male around 72 years in recent readings. Thailand has completed the demographic transition and is aging.

candidates.title: Defence / military expenditure statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from official budget and international compilations (SIPRI-aligned)
candidates.description: Estimates of military expenditure. Continuously referenced in security, fiscal and regional strategic analysis.

candidates.title: National defence and security policy framing
candidates.description: Policy framing of Thailand’s defence and security posture, including territorial integrity, internal security and regional cooperation. Continuously cited in strategic analysis.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the defence budget node.

candidates.title: Digital economy and e-commerce framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from commerce and platform sources
candidates.description: Framing and available statistics on digital commerce, e-commerce platforms and digitalisation of SMEs and retail. Strong growth in online sales volumes is a recurring feature.
candidates.notes: Digital densification of the services and commerce cluster.

candidates.title: Thailand health–defence–digital densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from NSO, defence and commerce sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding life expectancy statistics, defence expenditure and policy framing, and digital/e-commerce framing into a coherent health–security–digital residual layer.
